title: Nanci Danison Probable NDE 5458/9232/9636 NDE 9232
content:
9636:

There is a type of NDE that is rarely reported in the literature or on this website. I call it a 'meeting with Council' afterlife visit. It takes place in the afterlife just like other deep NDEs do, but the elements are very different. I have had two of these meetings. Natalie Sudman's book 'Applicaton of Impossible Things' describes her Council meeting in the afterlife. This is a description of my second Council meeting.

My second meeting with the Council of Light Beings occurred seven years after my full, deep, transcendental afterlife experience (in 1994). It was more dramatic and traumatic than my first one, where I was simply told to get started working my mission. During this one, in 2001, I once again returned to the afterlife to what appeared to be a hastily called gathering in the Light. The manifested Earth-like setting appeared more like a conference room than a formal hearing chamber. It was very ephemeral in appearance and had no solid defining walls or features. The Light Being members were settling into what might have been chairs around a crowded table when I arrived. Three Council members joined the group after I did, lending credence to my impression of spontaneity. Two of the last three Beings to enter displayed the faces of Nanci’s deceased biological parents for just a second before that illusion was replaced with their luminescent Light Being forms. My Earthly parents’ participation both thrilled and shocked me. Their human hosts had died years before this Council meeting, so I was excited to see their faces again even for a moment. I felt they had given me the wonderful gift of recognition to reassure me in advance of the meeting about to take place. The fact that my human parents were on my Council disturbed me, however, as I felt I had not respected their guidance as well as I should have while they were in the body. (I might have taken them more seriously had I known they were going to be on my Council!)

The last Council member to arrive was alive and in human form, projected a sense of rush, and remained in human appearance the whole time. He sat one check of his human body tush on the edge of the table right in front of me while I was several feet away from it. When I raised my gaze to his, he looked me straight in the eye and mouthed the word 'surprise!' And I was surprised! I recognized this Being as a still living human I know this life as Jeff, though I cannot recall now which Jeff. I have known several. An alarm went off in my mind seeing someone from my human life, as if some emergency had triggered a recall of even undercover agents.

This second Council meeting was brief and to the point. The Light Beings told me telepathically that extremely difficult times lay ahead—-times that would cause me grave suffering. The Council acknowledged my body’s illness and weakened condition, intimating my human might not have sufficient strength to recover. The Council gave me the option of staying in human life, or remaining in the afterlife right then to avoid the suffering. They made it clear that if I chose to leave human life, it would not be considered a breach of contract on my part. (I had assigned myself the mission of telling people what I experienced in the afterlife after I returned to the body in 1994. That was the contract they were relieving me from performing.) If I stayed in my human host, they said, I must endure constant suffering for the rest of her life. Despite what they told me about my future, I chose to stay in human form. My motivation at the time was that I did not want to miss witnessing what is going to happen in Earth’s future, all of which was shown to me during my 1994 afterlife experience. More importantly, I did not want to be a failure at the mission Source gave me to tell everyone what I had experienced and learned in the afterlife in 1994. I felt a duty to my fellow souls incarnated into humans to give them that information and I love them enough to stay and do it.

When I awoke again inside Nanci immediately after making the decision to stay, I was certain the meeting had taken place. Yet the amnesia of human nature robbed me of the memory of whether the choice I had made was between suffering for the rest of Nanci's life, or, living through the most severe part of the transition in epochs (which I saw in the vision of Earth's future during my 1994 experience). All I know for certain is that my choice was to “go through with it.” The “it” part is now clear because Nanci and I have suffered greatly, physically and emotionally, since then.

arrival.other_being_detail: Council of Light Beings; one council member appeared as a still-living human acquaintance ('Jeff') in human form.

environment.environment_other_detail: Manifested Earth-like setting like a 'conference room' with a crowded table; 'very ephemeral' with 'no solid defining walls or features.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She describes a mission/contract to "tell everyone what I had experienced and learned in the afterlife" (from her 1994 experience) and chose to stay to avoid being "a failure at the mission Source gave me."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonstandard 'Council meeting' format; deceased parents briefly appeared with recognizable faces before reverting to luminescent Light Being forms; one council member appeared as a still-living human acquaintance ('Jeff').
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/OBE described; immediate arrival into a Light-based council gathering, telepathic briefing, explicit choice to stay or remain in afterlife, then immediate return on choosing to stay.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A rarely reported 'meeting with Council' afterlife visit in an ephemeral, conference-room-like setting; council included Light Beings, deceased parents briefly showing their faces, and one still-living human acquaintance in human form.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: He looked me straight in the eye and mouthed the word 'surprise!' / My choice was to "go through with it."
